question:
**Direction: Select the word from the options that is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

The pandemic has seen soaring home prices and record housing **(insecurity)**.
solution:
The correct answer is "Firmness."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Insecurity" means uncertainty or anxiety about oneself; lack of confidence. (असुरक्षा)

 
 
• Example: *Their aggressive behaviour is really a sign of **insecurity**__.*
 
 
 
• The option that is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word is **"Firmness."**
 
• The word "Firmness" means the quality of having a solid, almost unyielding surface or structure. (कठोरता; दृढ़ता)
 __
 
• Example:* The new teacher has a reputation for **firmness**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Hesitancy: **the quality or state of being hesitant. (झिझकने की अवस्था या भाव)
 
• **Self-doubt: **lack of confidence in oneself and one's abilities. (स्वयं और अपनी क्षमताओं पर विश्वास की कमी)
 
• **Pretence: **an action that makes people believe something that is not true. (प्रदर्शन, ढोंग, दिखावा)
